scope: Owner requested fixing bug-3 source compatibility gaps now; same draft PR #8, no IPA or merge.
status: Further source gaps patched and host-tested: profile-5 RPU rendering, bounded/adaptive embedded subtitle preroll and selected-language VobSub. iPhoneOS candidate validation and actual Drive/Roku acceptance pending; no 100% device claim.
implemented: MP4/MOV/M4V files and extensionless file bytes reach codec-aware HLS copy/conversion; native HLS remains direct.
Pinned dav1d AV1 software decoder; iOS requests native VideoToolbox AV1, with fallback on hardware initialization or initial decode failure.
Additional MPEG-PS, ASF/WMV, FLV, Ogg, RM, WTV and NUT demuxers and native video/audio decoders; enabled unsupported audio bridges adaptively to AAC.
Convert unsupported H.264/HEVC profiles/bit depths/chroma formats; offer third-party compatibility for 4K H.264.
HDR10/PQ and HLG high-precision RGB tone/gamut mapping to SDR, resized before color mapping; preserve source metadata, keep SDR GPU path.
Palette-bitmap burn-in for embedded PGS/DVD/DVB/XSUB with bounded 32 MiB/256-rectangle cache, timing/clear/scaling/alpha and backward seeking.
MOV sample-table presentation timestamps fix open-GOP copy/conversion alignment without reading every keyframe; sparse beginning/end indexes no longer create giant segments.
Previous pass preserved native profile-5 MP4; superseded below by RPU-aware SDR compatibility routing.
Source seek/read/reconnect timing in conversion logs, alongside total production and queue wait; abort logs retain timing without labeling user stop a conversion failure.
Bound HTTP probing to 256 KiB and subsequent ranges to 1 MiB, with optional keep-alive; fresh AVIO retries open directly at the requested offset under one read deadline, retaining stop interrupts.

Local external SUP and IDX/SUB lazy demuxing, long-cue/far/backward/clear handling and bounded bitmap rendering; app discovery/selection includes those formats and skips incomplete IDX/SUB pairs. Later subtitle input errors propagate through conversion.

Profile-5 RPU polynomial/MMR reshaping, nonlinear offsets/matrices, PQ linearization and RPU/HPE color conversion before SDR mapping; validated metadata and one-dimensional PQ tables, source mastering luminance retained.
Profile-5 configuration selects receiver-independent SDR compatibility conversion; missing RPU fails explicitly instead of passing unreshaped IPT pixels.
Embedded subtitle preroll observes video timestamps to stop at the target instead of waiting for a future caption; expands cold lookback when no display state was recovered; new scan-end telemetry.
External VobSub follows Kodi language aliases through fresh/backward rendering; real two-language bitmaps verify selection and uppercase companion matching.

Canceled speculative conversions interrupt an already-bound network source wait through the converter cancellation predicate. Next segment flushes parser/error state and recovers source reads; canceled partial output cannot reach the cache. Connected foreground requests remain protected by scheduler ownership.

coverage: Actual decoded forward target, backward seek, retry and audio on each added format.
PQ/HLG pixel mapping, neutral chroma, black/highlights, source metadata preserved; tone mapping changes pixels.
Real synthetic PGS decoder/palette/alpha/clear tests in planar/NV12 and whole burned-video pixel/timestamp comparison.
Native Dolby route with synthetic config only, not profile-5 pixel correctness.
Finite-range-only endpoint, complete byte equality across initial/subsequent ranges, EOF, forward/backward seeks, dropped-response recovery and shared timeout budget.

External real PGS and DVD/VobSub decoders: pixels in NV12/planar output, long cue on a fresh far seek, duration/clear/backward replay, 302-cue cache bound, corrupt input and whole burned-video comparisons.
Real HEVC RPU decode, profile-5 RGB/SDR output, decoded target/backward retry/audio; exact dyadic MMR orders/all cross-term equivalence and corrupt-offset rejection.
Cold seek into 59-second embedded PGS cue, actual decoded subtitle pixels and scan ending on target video, backward retry; selected English/Spanish VobSub bitmaps.
Transient network wait cancellation and exact-byte recovery after resetting its condition, plus full overlapping HTTP seek/prefetch/stop suite.

added_media_fixtures: External long SUP with 302 cues including a 59-second display set
External DVD/VobSub IDX and companion MPEG program-stream SUB generated from synthetic PGS

ffmpeg_patch.scope: Small presentation-time accessor, no media I/O or full-file scan.

verification.builds: Expanded FFmpeg 8.1.1/dav1d built on Linux; 1,381 checks compiled with the host MPEG-4 test encoder. iPhoneOS candidate compile pending separately; no IPA or release.
verification.framework_built_or_published: Candidate framework compiled and uploaded as a CI artifact; no framework release published; r11 pin unchanged.
verification.native_ios_compile: First framework candidate successfully compiled against the iPhoneOS SDK; latest transient-read addition has a separate candidate rerun pending.

ffmpeg.configuration_license: LGPL version 2.1 or later; no GPL/nonfree flags
ffmpeg.modification: Shipped LGPL MOV timestamp accessor patch. Host source initialized from the same signed upstream tag, patch identity separately checked against the commit archive.

dav1d.license: BSD-2-Clause; unmodified; license/config copied into framework by build recipe
dav1d.ios_recipe: Optimized ARM assembly, explicit iPhoneOS cross file; not compiled here

validation_recovery: Expanded first run exposed managed YUV output saturating neutral chroma, a misleading single midpoint assertion and a MOV-derived frame-rate rational unsupported by the host MPEG-4 encoder. RGB mapping + proven final pack corrected the chroma defect; a darker ramp sample distinguishes tone mapping, and bounded rational reduction retains timestamps.
Program-stream probing required the raw MPEG-video demuxer. Its sparse start/end-only index also needed a dense-index guard.

Constant MOV decode/presentation offset failed alignment by about 125 ms because open-GOP offsets vary. Use existing per-sample presentation times through the pinned accessor instead. First accessor compile failed its missing-prototype warning; added declaration, rebuilt and checked the patch against clean source.
Generated PGS initially shifted its first cue to zero during fixture muxing; preserve source timestamps with copyts. Decoded-pixel and clear tests then pass.

The synthetic Dolby configuration fixture was not emitting dvcC at default mux strictness; enable unofficial compliance in the fixture writer only. Native route and cleanup checks pass after correction.
Publication scanner initially rejected four newly required source/build files. Added only their exact paths to the existing remux allowlist; no secret/private/binary rules removed.

The old Python static source assertion required reconnect_delay_max/AVSEEK_FORCE and failed after replacement of nested HTTP retries. Removed only that obsolete implementation-string assertion; compiled byte-accuracy/fault/deadline regressions validate behavior, plus two new Python bitmap-discovery/selection tests.
First native DOVI test compile needed the fixture_dir forward declaration; corrected before execution.
Initial annotated HEVC fixture mux failed unknown timestamps with B frames; use a zero-B-frame synthetic fixture and generated timestamps. Existing separate open-GOP/4K fixtures remain.

An approximate 3D color LUT lost accuracy around saturated black and was rejected. Use direct polynomial/MMR and matrices with one-dimensional PQ tables. Ordinary YCbCr bars are not physical profile-5 colors; generate test IPT from valid BT.2020/PQ RGB with inverse RPU matrices for independent comparison.

System libplacebo 7.349 uses the older code/(2^N-1) convention. Reference explicitly matches raw chroma filtering and normalizes to current pinned code/2^BL convention; comparisons include a reference-with-RPU-disabled negative control.

First two-language VobSub test failed because its generated second IDX offset pointed at the first language. Derive per-stream sector offsets from ffprobe; distinct Spanish/English pixel and backward tests then pass.

First isolated clean CI: native framework job passed; Linux host job failed two first-frame DOVI metadata checks (1378 checks executed). Older fixture-generating FFmpeg associated trailing first-frame RPU with another access unit. Change insertion to prefix the single slice; local first-frame test and independent comparison pass, clean CI rerun required.
limits: HDR software color mapping, AV1 hardware fallback, sustained 4K/24–60 fps and actual TV acceptance still need a newly built framework and phone results.
Long Drive seeks are not declared resolved. Source I/O telemetry narrows the next capture; a blocked or obsolete foreground read may still delay a new request.
Published KodiAirPlay r11 is unchanged. Build/publish a new framework, verify/pin it before any separately requested IPA. No release or merge.

Bounded ranges add HTTP round trips; the synthetic stalled-read deadline result is not a phone seek-speed improvement. Dedicated external subtitle replay can reread that local subtitle file after backward seeks; it does not scan movie bytes.
No universal every-file/every-receiver guarantee or Dolby certification. Profile-5 CPU rendering and all 4K/frame-rate hardware paths need phone/TV throughput and color acceptance.

Overlapping long text histories and every container/profile combination are not exhaustively verified. Recovering state in unindexed embedded streams can require earlier reads. Arbitrary HLS codec conversion remains outside the native-playlist path.

transient_source_followup.scope: Bind the converter cancellation predicate after opening; canceled background conversions interrupt source waits and discard partial output. Clear parser/error state on the next job; preserve the foreground-only cancellation boundary.
